text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the triathlon has arrived...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This is it! Tannhauser, you feeling A-OK?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Sorry I was out of action for a while,
but thankfully I'm all healed
up now and
ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Today I mean business! Ei, ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's the spirit! But we don't want
you getting any nosebleeds,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh... yeah, I forgot. Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Spe, you okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh, I-I-I'm super nervous! How am I
supposed to go out there like
this?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If you're finding it hard to calm down, how
about trying some
visualizations? For
example, you could imagine winning the
grand
prize and having the all-you-can-eat
buffet!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! The buffet! Let's see, there's...
seafood cocktail, roast
beef...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! There's all kinds of potatoes in the
German cottage fries too!
And they've got
acqua pazza...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that seems to have done the trick.
Everyone, let's make sure we
get that
buffet! We're in this to win it!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I brim with delight when I imagine this
auditorium packed with
spectators! Is
everyone ready?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh, uhhh... I-I-I guess... No! I always
forget something. I-I'm just
gonna check
one more time!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
We're all meeting at the venue, right? I'm
heading off now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um, thank you for doing the triathlon with
me. I feel really glad that I
get to be on
such a great team.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Is this the time to be getting all soppy?
We haven't competed yet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'll give it everything I've got! I
promise I won't let you down!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You're way too serious about this. It's not like it's your responsibility to win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's not about responsibility. I want my
running to make you all proud.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Ayabe, Top Road! We're going to
head out now too. See you
there!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's win this together!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Warm spring sun and clear blue skies are
here to welcome the
long-awaited Tracen
Academy Team Triathlon!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
There are eight teams competing today,
making for thirty-two
athletes in total. Our
competitors are currently ready and
waiting on
the academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wow! There's so many spectators! All this
excitement's getting my
heart pounding!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Lots of television cameras, too! My father
said he would be watching
from his office!

text_block_list.name: Shook Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the lineup on Team Bakushin is
insane! What, are they going
all out for
the special award or something?!

text_block_list.name: Naysayer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, they have some total newbies on
their team, though. It's nice
they wanna
take part and all, but they better not get
in the way.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Keh heh heh... How exciting it is to think
that all their jabbering will
turn into bitter
cries of agony! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Quite! When the audience witnesses how I
shatter the limits of
stamina, they will gasp
in astonishment!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha!
Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Heh... Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita, I know we can hold our own out
there. Just think—we put up a
good fight
against our seniors in the joint training,
didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah... We even won!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We've proven we stand a chance. So let's
hold our heads up high!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's be confident and go all out!
We'll show them what we've
got!
